title: GeniL: A Multilingual Dataset on Generalizing Language
measurement_description: Detection of generalizing language (stereotypes) involving religious identity groups as part of a broader analysis of various social identities.
findings: The paper includes religious identity as a category for detecting generalizing language but does not present specific findings for religious groups. The general findings, such as the inadequacy of simple co-occurrence metrics for stereotype detection and the effectiveness of the proposed GeniL dataset for training classifiers, apply to religious contexts as well. An example sentence in Bengali involving Muslims is used to illustrate the task, and the term 'Jew' is mentioned as a racial/religious identity term.
